blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A simulation of a real robot workspace must preserve task-relevant interactions, while policies developed in it must operate on observations available to the real robot. Yet scene reconstruction and policy development are often treated separately. We present Agentic Real-to-Sim-to-Real (Agentic RSR), a framework that links scene reconstruction, policy development, and real-robot execution through the same manipulation task. Given a workspace video, a task description, and a known robot model, an agent recovers metric scale, iteratively refines the scene using visual feedback, and checks task-relevant interactions in MuJoCo. A coding agent then develops an executable policy, progressing from privileged object poses to visual observations and randomized simulation. The policy can interleave multiple observations and actions within one invocation, while the agent uses execution feedback to continue, retry, or revise its approach. A shared task-level interface carries the policy and accumulated experience to the real robot, where fresh observations and safety checks guide execution. Across 18 reconstructed scenes involving two robots, the mean four-view Depth MAE against reference depth estimates is 0.1057 m, the mean Lab $ΔE_{76}$ is 11.04, and the mean grayscale SSIM is 0.6990. In real-robot experiments, the aggregate task success rate reaches 80% of the simulation task success rate, indicating substantial retention of simulated performance on hardware. Code and reconstructed scene data will be made publicly available.
blocks.zh: 对真正的机器人工作空间的模拟必须保持与任务相关的相互作用,而其中制定的政策必须运行在真正的机器人可用的观测上. 然而,现场重建和政策制定往往分开处理。 我们提出Agentic Real-to-Sim-to-Real(Agentic RSR),这个框架通过同样的操纵任务将现场重建,政策制定和真机器人执行联系起来. 鉴于一个工作空间视频,任务描述,以及已知的机器人模型,一个特工恢复了度量尺度,利用视觉反馈对场景进行迭代精细化,并检查了MuJoCo中与任务相关的互动. 然后,一个编码代理制定可执行政策,从特权对象的姿势发展到视觉观察和随机模拟。 该政策可以将多种意见和行动放在一种援引中,而代理人则利用执行反馈来继续、重复或修改其做法。 共享的任务级别接口将政策和积累的经验带给真正的机器人,在那里,新的观察和安全检查指导执行。 横跨18个涉及两个机器人的重建场景,平均四视深度MAE相对于参考深度估计为0.1057米,平均Lab $ΔE_{76}$为11.04,平均灰度SSIM为0.6990. 在真机器人实验中,总任务成功率达到模拟任务成功率的80%,表明在硬件上模拟性能的大量保留. 将公布代码和重建的场景数据。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Developing and evaluating robot policies through real-world trials is costly and difficult to scale. Simulation offers an alternative for policy evaluation and training ( Li et al., 2025 ; Ranawaka et al., 2026 ) . For a policy intended to return to a captured workspace, the simulated scene must support task-relevant interactions, and the policy must operate on observations available to the real robot.
blocks.zh: 通过现实世界的试验来制定和评估机器人政策是代价高昂的,而且难以推广。 模拟为政策评价和培训提供了一个替代办法(Li等人,2025年;Ranawaka等人,2026年)。 对于旨在返回被捕获的工作空间的政策,模拟场景必须支持与任务相关的互动,而政策必须运行在真正机器人可用的观测上.

blocks.en: Existing systems already bridge parts of this chain. Re 3 Sim reconstructs interactive scenes and demonstrates sim-to-real policy transfer ( Han et al., 2025 ) ; Agentic Real2Sim uses vision-language agents to build physics-based episodic scenes for downstream policy evaluation and fine-tuning ( Chen et al., 2026a ) ; and SimFoundry turns video into interactive scenes for simulation-based evaluation and sim-to-real policy training ( Ranawaka et al., 2026 ) . In programmatic control, Code as Policies generates executable programs over perception and control APIs ( Liang et al., 2023 ) , while CaP-X studies multi-turn execution feedback and transfers code-based policies using tools shared across simulation and reality ( Fu et al., 2026 ) . This motivates a more specific question: how can agent-refined reconstruction of an observed workspace be coupled with an execution-grounded programmatic policy and a consistent task-level interface across simulation and hardware?
blocks.zh: 现有的系统已经连接了这一链条的组成部分。 Re 3 Sim重建互动场景,并展示对现实的政策转移(Han 等人,2025年); Agentic Real2Sim使用视觉语言代理构建基于物理学的外观场景,用于下游政策评价和微调(Chen 等人,2026a年);SimFoundry将视频转换成互动场景,用于模拟评价和对现实的政策培训(Ranawaka等人,2026年). 在方案控制中,《作为政策的准则》产生可执行的程序,以取代感知和控制API(Liang等人,2023年),而CaP-X则利用模拟和现实共享的工具研究多回合执行反馈和转移基于代码的政策(Fu等人,2026年)。 这引发了一个更具体的问题:如何在对观测到的工作空间进行精细的重建的同时,制定基于执行的方案政策,如何在模拟和硬件之间建立一致的任务层面接口?

blocks.en: We present Agentic Real-to-Sim-to-Real (Agentic RSR) to study this connection. Given a workspace video, a task, and a known robot, a Codex agent ( OpenAI, 2026 ) reconstructs a metrically aligned, interactive scene and refines it against visual and task-relevant physical checks. The same Codex agent ( OpenAI, 2026 ) then develops an executable programmatic policy, progressing from privileged object poses to visual observations and randomized simulation. The policy may be revised during development, but its version is locked during final evaluation. A shared task-level interface carries the policy and experience memory to hardware, where fresh observations and execution feedback support verification and recovery. Real-robot experiments show that the policies retain much of their aggregate task performance after transfer from simulation.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍Agentic Real-to-Sim-to-Real(Agentic RSR)来研究这种联系. 由于一个工作空间视频,一个任务,以及一个已知的机器人,一个Codex代理(OpenAI,2026年)重建了一个以公尺对齐,互动的场景,并针对视觉和任务相关的物理检查对其进行完善. 同一Codex代理(OpenAI, 2026)随后开发出可执行的程序政策,从特权对象面孔向视觉观察和随机模拟发展. 在制订期间可以修订政策,但其版本在最后评价时锁定。 共享的任务层面接口将政策和经验内存带给硬件,在那里,新的观察和执行反馈支持核查和恢复。 Real-robot实验显示,这些政策在从模拟转移后保留了大部分的总任务性能.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • Agentic Real-to-Sim scene reconstruction for executable tasks. We anchor the metric scale of a video-reconstructed workspace to known robot geometry, iteratively reconstruct the scene using reference views and depth and appearance feedback, and check task-relevant geometric and physical interactions so that the scene supports robot execution; • An execution-grounded programmatic policy developed by a Codex agent. The Codex agent ( OpenAI, 2026 ) generates a policy bundle containing a complete program and reusable steps. The bundle remains locked during an episode, while the Codex agent ( OpenAI, 2026 ) uses execution results and fresh observations to decide whether to continue, switch steps, retry, or recover; • A unified Agentic Real-to-Sim-to-Real closed-loop framework. A consistent task-level observation and action interface connects scene reconstruction, simulation-based policy testing, and hardware execution, where execution feedback supports verification and recovery.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:为可执行的任务进行代理性Real-to-Sim场景重建。 我们把一个视频重构的工作空间的尺度固定在已知的机器人几何上,利用参考视图和深度及外观反馈,迭代重建现场,并检查与任务相关的几何和物理互动,以便现场支持机器人执行; • 一个Codex代理商制定的基于执行的程序政策. Codex代理(OpenAI, 2026)生成一个包含完整程序和可重复使用的步骤的政策包. 捆绑在一集中仍然锁定,而Codex代理(OpenAI,2026)则使用执行结果和新鲜的观察来决定是继续,切换步骤,重试,还是恢复; • 统一的Agentic Real-to-Sim-to-Real close-loop框架. 一个一致的任务级观测和行动接口连接现场重建,模拟政策测试,以及硬件执行,执行反馈支持核查和恢复.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: RL-GSBridge and GSWorld combine high-fidelity scene representations with robot simulation, while Re 3 Sim and RoboSimGS couple rendering with interaction geometry for manipulation and sim-to-real learning ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ; Han et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) . RoboSnap builds simulation-ready scenes from a single RGB image ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Scalable Real2Sim recovers physics-aware assets through robot interaction, whereas TwinAligner addresses visual and dynamic alignment for policy transfer ( Pfaff et al., 2025 ; Fan et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: RL-GSBridge和GSWorld将高真实度场景表现与机器人模拟相结合,而Re 3 Sim和RoboSimGS夫妇的渲染与交互几何,用于操纵和模拟现实学习(Wu等人,2025年;Jiang等人,2026年;Han等人,2025年;Zhao等人,2026年). RoboSnap从单一的RGB图像构建模拟准备场景(张等,2026年). 可缩放现实2 Sim通过机器人互动来回收具有物理学意识的资产,而TwinAligner则针对政策转移的视觉和动态调整(Pfaff等人,2025年;Fan等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: ACDC generates digital cousins that preserve task-relevant affordances, while SIMPLER studies how simulated evaluation relates to real-robot performance ( Dai et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . Holodeck generates prompt-conditioned environments; Gen2Sim produces 3D assets, tasks, and rewards for robot learning ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Katara et al., 2024 ) . SceneSmith, PhyScensis, SimWorld Studio, and Articraft respectively explore vision-language scene generation, physics-guided arrangement, coding-agent environments, and programmatic articulated assets ( Pfaff et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Kang et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) . Closer to video-based real-to-sim, Agentic Real2Sim uses agents and simulator-in-the-loop refinement to turn recorded robot–object interactions into simulatable episodic twins, while SimFoundry generates interactive scenes and digital cousins for policy evaluation and sim-to-real training ( Chen et al., 2026a ; Ranawaka et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: ACDC生成数字表亲,保留与任务相关的负担,而SIMPLER则研究模拟评价如何与实际机器人性能相关(Dai等人,2025年;Li等人,2025年)。 Holodeck生成快速条件的环境;Gen2Sim为机器人学习提供3D资产,任务,以及奖励(Yang等人,2024年;Katara等人,2024年). SceneSmith,PhyScensis,SimWorld Studio,以及Articraft分别探索视觉语言场景生成,物理指导安排,编码剂环境,以及程序化的清晰资产(Pfaff等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年b;Kang等人,2026年;周等人,2026年). 离视频真实对映更近一些,Agentic Real2Sim使用代理和模拟器即时改进,将录制的机器人-对象相互作用变为可模拟的上位双胞胎,而SimFoundry则产生互动场景和数字表弟,用于政策评价和模拟对现实的培训(Chen等人,2026a;Ranawaka等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Code as Policies and Instruct2Act compose perception and actions into executable programs ( Liang et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2023a ) . SayCan pairs language planning with feasible pretrained skills, while VoxPoser uses 3D value maps for closed-loop trajectory planning ( ichter et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2023b ) . Inner Monologue incorporates environmental feedback into planning; CaP-X studies multi-turn coding agents and code-policy transfer across simulation and hardware ( Huang et al., 2023c ; Fu et al., 2026 ) . ASPIRE and ENPIRE explore feedback-driven skill development; Show-Harness offers a semantic action interface, and RoboClaw orchestrates learned primitives for long-horizon tasks ( Lu et al., 2026 ; Xiao et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 《政策和指令法》(Liang等人,2023年;Huang等人,2023年a) SayCan将语言规划与可行的预训技能配对,而VoxPoser则使用3D值图进行闭路轨道规划(ichter等人,2023年;Huang等人,2023年b). 内部独角兽将环境反馈纳入规划;CaP-X研究跨模拟和硬件的多回合编码剂和密码政策转移(Huang等人,2023c;Fu等人,2026). ASPIRE和ENPIRE探索反馈驱动的技能开发;Show-Harness提供了一个语义动作界面,RoboClaw管弦乐团为长视野任务学习原始人(Lu等人,2026年;Xiao等人,2026年;Chen等人,2026年b;Li等人,2026年).

blocks.en: Visual and dynamics randomization support sim-to-real transfer ( Tobin et al., 2017 ; Peng et al., 2018 ) , while RT-2, OpenVLA, Octo, and π 0 \pi_{0} develop data-driven visuomotor rather than executable robot policies ( Zitkovich et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2025 ; Ghosh et al., 2024 ; Black et al., 2025 ) . Our focus is to connect reconstruction of a particular captured workspace with a programmatic policy for the same task, evaluated in simulation and on real robots.
blocks.zh: 视觉和动态随机化支持sim-to-real transferation(Tobin等人,2017年;Peng等人,2018年),而RT-2,OpenVLA,Octo,和Qπ0\pi_{0}开发数据驱动的粘液电动机而不是可执行的机器人政策(Zitkovich等人,2023年;Kim等人,2025年;Ghosh等人,2024年;Black等人,2025年). 我们的重点是将重建一个特定的工作空间与一项方案政策联系起来,以完成同样的任务,在模拟中和在真正的机器人上进行评估。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Real-to-Sim scene reconstruction for executable tasks
blocks.zh: 3.1 可执行任务的真到真场景重建

blocks.en: Given a continuous RGB video V V of a workspace, a task description q q , and a known robot asset U U , we aim to reconstruct the particular captured workspace rather than generate a semantically similar scene variant. The resulting scene should reproduce task-relevant geometry and appearance from reference views while providing collision and physical representations that support robot–object interaction. The workflow connects robot-anchored metric registration, feedback-guided agentic scene reconstruction, and task-interaction checks in MuJoCo ( Todorov et al., 2012 ) . The robot asset U U supplies both a metric geometric reference and the kinematic model used in downstream simulation.
blocks.zh: 鉴于一个工作空间的连续RGB视频V V,一个任务描述 q q,以及一个已知的机器人资产 U U,我们的目标是重建特定的捕获的工作空间,而不是产生一个类似场景的变体. 由此产生的场景应当从参考视图中复制与任务相关的几何和外观,同时提供碰撞和物理表现,支持机器人-对象交互. 该工作流程连接机器人-安居度量衡注册,反馈引导的代理场景重建,以及MujoCo的任务交互检查(Todorov等人,2012年)。 机器人资产U U同时提供在下游模拟中使用的度量几何参考和运动模型.

blocks.en: We sample 32 frames from V V and select four as fixed reference views for subsequent scene reconstruction. VGGT- Ω \Omega ( Wang et al., 2026a ) estimates camera intrinsics K v K_{v} , world-to-camera extrinsics E v E_{v} , and depth d v d_{v} for sampled frame v v , while SAM3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) supplies robot masks. Back-projecting masked depths yields a robot point cloud in the reconstruction frame. We align the known meter-scale URDF surface with this cloud using multi-scale Sim(3) registration, followed by local pose and scale refinement. Let T B → G T_{B\rightarrow G} denote the similarity transform from robot-base frame B B to reconstruction frame G G , with scale s s measured in reconstruction units per meter. Applying T B → G − 1 T_{B\rightarrow G}^{-1} expresses the reconstructed scene and camera poses in the metric robot-base frame; dividing the estimated depths by s s converts them to meters while preserving their relative geometry. Candidate registrations are ranked by projected-mask agreement, bidirectional point-cloud fit, coverage, and depth consistency. Appendix B specifies the objective and search settings.

blocks.en: We invoke Codex agents ( OpenAI, 2026 ) through a Python SDK. A planning session first receives q q and four real reference RGB images and produces a plan for task objects, background elements, and spatial relationships. A separate refinement session receives this plan, the initial Blender ( Blender Foundation, 2026 ) scene, the fixed reference-camera status, the real images, and RGB previews of the current scene. Across successive rounds, it edits object geometry, relative layout, materials, and lighting. The robot and four reference cameras are frozen by the execution program and cannot be changed by the agent. The agent can use Blender ( Blender Foundation, 2026 ) Lab MCP tools for scene editing and preview when available. In each round, the refinement agent renders and inspects the candidate before submitting a Blender ( Blender Foundation, 2026 ) Python edit script. An external runner applies the script, checks the frozen assets, saves a separate candidate version, and renders and evaluates it from the four reference views. The agent receives scalar feedback for overall depth and appearance error; acceptance is determined by the programmatic evaluator rather than the agent’s self-assessment.
blocks.zh: 我们通过一个Python SDK援引Codex代理(OpenAI,2026). 一个规划会话首先接收q q和四个真实的参考RGB图像,并生成任务对象,背景要素和空间关系的计划. 一个单独的完善会话收到这个计划,最初的Blender(Blender Foundation,2026)场景,固定的参考镜头状态,真实的图像,以及当前场景的RGB预览. 它通过连续的回合来编辑物体几何,相对布局,材料,以及照明. 机器人和四台参考摄像头被执行程序冻结,不能由代理机改变. 该代理可以使用Blender(Blender Foundation, 2026) Lab MCP工具,在可用时用于场景编辑和预览. 在每轮中,完善代理在提交Blender(Blender Foundation,2026) Python编辑脚本之前,先制作并检查候选人. 一个外部执行员应用脚本,检查被冻结的资产,保存一个单独的候选版本,并从四个参考观点中制作和评价。 代理人收到关于总体深度和外观错误的分级反馈;接受与否由方案评价者决定,而不是代理人的自我评估。

blocks.en: For reference view v v , the evaluator records metric depth error D v D_{v} , Lab color difference C v C_{v} , and valid rendered-depth coverage Q v Q_{v} . Equal-weight averages over the four views give D ¯ \overline{D} and C ¯ \overline{C} . The joint visual check requires D ¯ < 0.15 \overline{D}<0.15 m and C ¯ < 15 \overline{C}<15 , together with D v < 0.20 D_{v}<0.20 m, C v < 30 C_{v}<30 , and Q v ≥ 0.50 Q_{v}\geq 0.50 for every view. Otherwise, refinement continues or records failure at the iteration limit. Reaching the mean-depth threshold alone does not establish full acceptance. Since the reference depths come from the preceding video reconstruction, D v D_{v} measures consistency with that metric reference rather than geometric error against independently measured ground truth. Per-scene results appear in Appendix C .

It classifies meshes as visual-only elements, static support or collision geometry, or movable or articulated task objects. These classifications are reviewable physical hypotheses, not measurements of real object properties. An exporter then combines the scene with the known robot model to generate a MuJoCo ( Todorov et al., 2012 ) scene 𝒮 M \mathcal{S}_{M} with appropriate collision representations and simulated physical properties. A separate Codex physics-checking session ( OpenAI, 2026 ) can use repository-provided inspection tools to examine task-object states and run settling, simplified grasp, or articulated-motion probes. Where justified, it tests a separate candidate with changes to collision geometry, object pose, or physical parameters. The runner records tool calls and reports and reruns the relevant probes on revised candidates; visible geometry or pose changes also trigger regression checks from the fixed reference views.

blocks.en: 3.2 Simulation-based policy generation and execution
blocks.zh: 3.2 基于模拟的政策制定和执行

blocks.en: Policy development proceeds through three successive passes. First, ground-truth object poses are temporarily available in the nominal scene, allowing the agent to establish task decomposition and action logic. Second, this privileged access is removed: the policy must estimate object state through the visual observation interface intended for subsequent real-robot use and complete the task in the nominal scene. Third, the same visual interface is retained while bounded variation is introduced in initial object positions, camera pose and calibration, and action execution. This pass tests whether the policy adapts to new observations and execution outcomes. The agent may revise its policy within each pass; when it judges the task complete from observations, it renders a final frame as evidence before passing the policy and experience notes to a fresh agent conversation for the next pass. These passes constitute iterative development; the submitted policy version is held fixed during final evaluation, while its actions can still respond to observations.
blocks.zh: 政策制订工作连续三个阶段进行。 首先,地面真实物体的姿势在标点场景中是暂时可用的,使代理人能够建立任务分解和动作逻辑. 其次,这一特权访问被移除:政策必须通过旨在后续真实机器人使用的视觉观测接口来估计对象状态,并在名义场景中完成任务. 第三,在初始对象位置、相机姿势和校准以及动作执行中引入限定变量的同时,保留同样的视觉接口。 这一通过测试了该政策是否适应新的观察和执行结果。 代理人可在每张通行证内修改其政策;当从观察中判断任务完成后,在将政策和经验说明传递给新的代理人谈话以进行下一次通行证之前,将最后框架作为证据。 这些通行证构成迭代发展;所提交的政策版本在最后评价期间固定不变,而其行动仍能对意见作出反应。

blocks.en: The simulator loads a reconstructed MuJoCo ( Todorov et al., 2012 ) scene and provides a consistent task-level interface for Piper and Franka. State and observation interfaces provide the end-effector state, estimated wrist-camera pose, gripper state, wrist and third-person images, and object-position estimates derived from wrist RGB-D and SAM3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) . Action interfaces support end-effector pose commands, gripper control, and sparse trajectories; control-flow interfaces support scene reset, yielding control, and stopping execution. Apart from the temporary object-pose access in the first pass, the visual policy cannot read simulator truth or rely on a built-in pick-and-place action or task-success oracle.
blocks.zh: 该模拟器加载了重建后的MujoCo(Todorov等人,2012年)场景,并为Piper和Franka提供了一个一致的任务级别界面. 状态和观测界面提供最终效应状态,估计腕相机的姿势,抓手状态,手腕和第三人称图像,以及从腕RGB-D和SAM3中得出的对象位置估计(Carion等人,2026年). 动作接口支持端效器摆出命令,抓取控制,以及稀少的轨迹;控制流接口支持场景重置,产生控制,并停止执行. 除了第一个通道中的临时对象-拥有访问,视觉策略不能读取模拟真理,也不能依赖内置的选址动作或任务成功甲骨文.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Three-stage policy development. The policy progresses from privileged skill acquisition to nominal interface verification and randomized robustness, passing validated policy and experience between stages.
blocks.zh: 图4:三阶段政策制定。 政策从获得特权技能发展到名义界面核查和随机化稳健性,在各阶段之间传递经过验证的政策和经验。

blocks.en: In each development pass, the Codex agent ( OpenAI, 2026 ) writes a programmatic policy using the task description and public interface. A single program execution may interleave repeated observations and actions. If execution fails or yields control, the runner returns action outcomes, errors, and recent observations to the same agent conversation. The agent can then continue from the current scene, reset and retry, or revise the policy before another execution. Yielding control preserves the scene state; resetting starts a new attempt and resamples perturbations in the randomized pass. The agent decides whether the task is complete from its observations and provides a final rendered frame as evidence; it does not receive a built-in task-success oracle.
blocks.zh: 在每个开发通行证中,Codex代理(OpenAI, 2026 )都会使用任务描述和公共界面来写一个程序政策. 单一程序执行可能会让重复的观察和行动相互间断. 如果执行失败或产生控制, 执行者会返回动作结果、 错误和最近的观察到同一代理对话中 。 然后代理可以从当前场景中继续,重置和重试,或者在另一个执行之前修改策略. ielding控件保留了场景状态;重置开始新的尝试,并在随机化的通行证中重新标注扰动. 代理商根据其观察结果决定任务是否完成,并提供最终制成的框架作为证据;它没有收到内置的任务成功预言.

blocks.en: 3.3 Sim-to-real transfer of policy and experience memory
blocks.zh: 3.3 政策和经验记忆的同步到实际转移

blocks.en: The simulation phase transfers two complementary forms of information: the policy retains validated task steps and observation–action logic, while experience memory summarizes effective behaviors, failure causes, perception difficulties, and actions to try or avoid. This memory helps the agent adapt to the real environment; it does not provide ground-truth object poses or simulator internals. A new agent conversation begins with the policy and experience memory but must re-localize objects and assess task state from current real observations rather than reuse simulated coordinates or success claims.
blocks.zh: 模拟阶段转移了两种互补形式的信息:政策保留了经过验证的任务步骤和观察-行动逻辑,而经验记忆则总结了有效的行为,失败的原因,认知困难,以及尝试或避免的行动. 这种内存有助于代理器适应真实环境;它不提供地面真实对象的姿势或模拟器的内部. 新的代理对话从政策和体验内存开始,但必须重新定位对象并从当前真实的观测中评估任务状态,而不是重复使用模拟坐标或成功声称.

blocks.en: During transfer, a robot-side safety mechanism automatically checks coordinate frames and camera calibration, enforces action limits and a safe workspace specific to the robot and task, and gates execution accordingly. Actions that violate these constraints are not executed. In parallel, the real-robot policy instructions require the agent to observe more frequently within a single program invocation, particularly before and after consequential actions, so that it reconfirms object locations and robot state before continuing, adjusting, or stopping. Real execution outcomes may update the experience memory; the agent assesses task completion from current observations rather than relying on a built-in success signal.
blocks.zh: 在转移期间,机器人侧安全机制自动检查坐标帧和相机校准,执行动作限制和机器人和任务特有的安全工作空间,并相应执行闸门. 不执行违反这些限制的行动。 同时,真机器人政策指示要求代理人在一个程序引用中更经常地观察,特别是在相应行动之前和之后,以便在继续,调整,或停止之前重新确认对象位置和机器人状态. 实际执行结果可能更新经验存储;代理从当前观察中评估任务完成情况,而不是依赖内置的成功信号.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate Agentic RSR on 18 real-world manipulation scenes and tasks across two robots, covering scene reconstruction, simulated and real-robot policy execution, and component ablations.
blocks.zh: 我们评价Agentic RSR在18个真实世界操纵场景和任务上横跨两个机器人,涵盖场景重建,模拟和真实机器人政策执行,以及组件喷发.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Each of the 18 tasks is paired with a workspace RGB video. All scene-reconstruction methods receive the same source video and select frames according to their input requirements; method-specific additional capture is reported separately. The camera slowly circles the workspace, with each frame showing the robot, scene, and task objects. Unless noted, Agentic RSR uses Codex agents ( OpenAI, 2026 ) powered by GPT-6 Astra with high reasoning effort; the model-swap ablation uses the stated alternative.
blocks.zh: 18项任务中的每一项任务都配有工作空间RGB视频. 所有场景重建方法都接收到相同的源视频,并根据其输入要求选择帧;方法特定的额外捕获单独报告. 相机缓慢地环绕工作空间,每个帧都显示机器人,场景,和任务对象. 除非注意,Agentic RSR使用由GPT-6 Astra提供动力的Codex代理(OpenAI,2026年),具有很高的推理功率;模型-swap expligion使用说明的替代品.

blocks.en: We measure scene quality with depth mean absolute error (Depth MAE), CIE 1976 Lab color difference (Lab Δ ​ E 76 \Delta E_{76} ), and structural similarity index measure (SSIM). When object-level geometry is available, we also report symmetric Chamfer distance (CD), F1 at a 1 cm threshold (F1@1cm), and bounding-box center error.
blocks.zh: 我们用深度平均绝对误差(深度MAE),CIE 1976 Lab色差(Lab Δ E 76\Delta E_{76}),以及结构相似性指数度量(SSIM)来衡量场景质量. 当对象级几何可用时,我们还报告对称的Chamfer距离(CD),1cm阈值(F1@1cm)的F1,以及边框-框中心错误.

blocks.en: For policy evaluation, task success rate (SR) is the fraction of completed tasks for Instruct2Act ( Huang et al., 2023a ) and Agentic RSR; Code as Policies ( Liang et al., 2023 ) instead reports a task-equal average of recorded real-robot attempts. We report simulation success rate (Sim SR) and real-robot success rate (Real SR). For Code as Policies and Instruct2Act, conversion is the descriptive ratio 100 × Real ​ SR / Sim ​ SR 100\times\mathrm{Real\ SR}/\mathrm{Sim\ SR} from unrounded rates; it is undefined when Sim SR is zero and is not paired task transfer. For Agentic RSR, conversion is the fraction of simulation-successful tasks that also succeed on the real robot. All aggregate results weight scenes or tasks equally.
blocks.zh: 就政策评价而言,任务成功率(SR)是Instruct2 Act(Huang等人,2023年a)和Agentic RSR(代理RSR);代码为Policy(Liang等人,2023年)所完成任务的一小部分,相反,报告的是记录的实机器人尝试的任务平均数。 我们报告模拟成功率(Sim SR)和真机器人成功率(Real SR). 对于作为政策和指令2的代码,转换是描述性比例 100×真SR / Sim SR 100\times\mathrm{Real\ SR}/\mathrm{Sim\ SR} 从未四舍五入的速率; 当Sim SR为零且不是配对的任务传输时, 它未定义 。 对于Agentic RSR,转换是模拟-成功任务中同样在真机器人上成功的一小部分. 所有累积结果加权场景或任务均匀.

blocks.en: 4.2 Real-to-Sim Scene Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 4.2 实景重建

blocks.en: We first test whether workspace videos can be converted into metric, visually consistent, task-relevant simulation scenes. Robot segmentation and registration use VGGT- Ω \Omega ( Wang et al., 2026a ) , SAM3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) , and the known robot URDF to recover scale and robot–camera alignment. Scene planning and refinement construct the task scene in Blender ( Blender Foundation, 2026 ) while keeping the registered robot and reference cameras fixed; the selected scene is converted to MuJoCo ( Todorov et al., 2012 ) for interaction.

All scenes reach mean Depth MAE < 0.15 <0.15 m by round 6; the mean first-hit and selected delivery rounds are 2.0 and 4.3. The depth threshold alone does not satisfy the complete acceptance criteria.

blocks.en: Across 42 measured objects, the scene-equal mean symmetric Chamfer distance is 0.0303 m, F1@1cm is 0.3655, and visible bounding-box center error is 0.0869 m. These results indicate that visual feedback improves appearance and depth consistency while recovering task-object arrangement. Per-scene results are provided in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 横跨42个测量对象,场景等值平均对称查姆费尔距离为0.0303米,F1@1cm为0.3655,可见边框-框中心误差为0.0869米. 这些结果表明,视觉反馈在恢复任务对象安排的同时,提高了外观和深度的一致性. 附录C提供了人均结果。

blocks.en: We additionally evaluate Re 3 Sim ( Han et al., 2025 ) , RL-GSBridge ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , RoboSimGS ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) , and SimFoundry ( Ranawaka et al., 2026 ) on the 18 task videos. All methods share the source videos, but differ in whether they process video directly or selected multi-view frames. Missing entries in Table 2 reflect output incompatibility: some methods produce images or Gaussian representations without depth or instance-level geometry directly usable here, not an inherent inability of Gaussian representations to produce depth. Among comparable metrics, Agentic RSR has the lowest depth and color errors, highest SSIM, and best available object-geometry scores, indicating preservation of task-object geometry and spatial relationships for downstream interaction. blocks.en: 4.3 Simulation and Real-Robot Policy Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.3 模拟和实际机器人政策评价

blocks.zh: 校对:Soup

blocks.en: We measure success under randomized simulation conditions and recorded real-robot attempts. Table 3 reports aggregate results; task IDs are listed in Appendix A .

blocks.en: Perception and manipulation technique both affect execution. A single wrist-camera view can be occluded or too narrow, and baseline records include cases where task objects were not recognized. Agentic RSR instead iterates on task steps in simulation and uses execution feedback to reobserve, adjust, or retry, responding to viewpoint changes and post-manipulation object states.

blocks.en: For example, bowl stacking requires stable grasp and placement contacts, not just object localization. Repeated simulation attempts let the agent encode such techniques in policy steps and experience for real-robot execution. Table 3 therefore captures revision from execution outcomes, not only one-shot action generation. Because Code as Policies ( Liang et al., 2023 ) hardware scenarios do not fully match the indexed tasks, real-robot comparisons remain descriptive rather than paired.

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablations
blocks.zh: 4.4 拖欠款项

blocks.en: We examine model choice, scalar metric feedback, and initial calibration on the same 18 scenes. blocks.en: 5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 限制

blocks.en: In our exploratory use of GPT-6 Astra, we observed noticeable differences in agent behavior across devices and invocation interfaces, as well as between runs on the same device at different times. These observations have not been measured under a controlled, matched-input protocol, so their causes remain unclear. Such variability makes agent behavior difficult to reproduce when relying on a closed-source model service. We hope for stronger transparency and oversight of these services, including clear model versioning and stable invocation interfaces, so that researchers can access them consistently and reasonably reproduce experimental results.
blocks.zh: 在我们探索性地使用GPT-6 Astra时,我们看到了不同设备之间的代理行为和引用界面以及不同时间在同一设备上的运行之间的明显差异。 这些观测结果尚未根据受控、匹配的输入协议进行测量,因此其原因仍不清楚。 这种可变性使得代理行为在依赖闭源模型服务时难以复制. 我们希望加强这些服务的透明度和监督,包括明确的模型版本和稳定的引用界面,以便研究人员能够持续和合理地复制实验结果。

blocks.en: Programmatic control and agent-driven revision present different trade-offs between execution speed and adaptability. Code as Policies (CaP) turns task instructions into executable programs that can themselves contain perception-feedback loops ( Liang et al., 2023 ) . Instruct2Act likewise generates programs that compose perception, planning, and robot actions from multimodal instructions ( Huang et al., 2023a ) . When execution encounters a case outside a program’s anticipated logic—such as perceptual confusion between similar-looking objects—a fixed program may have limited means to revise its subsequent strategy in light of the failure. Our approach allows a program to perform multiple observations and actions per invocation, while the agent uses execution feedback at checkpoints or after failures to decide how to proceed. This aims to balance execution efficiency and adaptability, but model-call latency and discrete checkpoints still limit our response to rapidly changing contacts compared with the high-frequency visuomotor control targeted by VLA policies such as π 0 \pi_{0} ( Black et al., 2025 ) . Future systems could combine high-level programmatic reasoning with faster low-level closed-loop control. Tools such as Jev ( Almeida, 2026 ) , designed for fast structured decisions, offer another direction to investigate, although their benefit for robot tasks remains to be established.
blocks.zh: 程序控制和代理驱动的修订在执行速度和适应性之间存在着不同的权衡. 代码为Policy(CaP) 将任务指令转化为可执行程序,它们本身可以包含感知反馈循环(Liang等人,2023年). 指令2 Act同样生成从多模式指令(Huang等人,2023年a)中构建感知、规划和机器人动作的程序。 当执行遇到一个超出程序预期逻辑的情况时——例如类似物体之间的感知混淆——固定程序可能会因失败而修改其后续战略的能力有限。 我们的方法允许一个程序在每次引用时进行多种观察和行动,而代理人在检查站使用执行反馈,或者在无法决定如何进行之后使用执行反馈. 这样做是为了平衡执行效率和适应性,但与VLA政策(例如 ^ 0\pi_{0}(Black等人,2025年))所针对高频粘摩托控制相比,模式调用时间和离散检查站仍然限制了我们对迅速变化的接触的反应。 未来的系统可以将高层次的方案推理与更快的低层次闭路控制结合起来。 Jev(Almeida,2026年)等工具是为快速结构化决定而设计的,为调查提供了另一个方向,尽管它们对机器人任务的好处仍有待确定.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We present Agentic RSR, a Real-to-Sim-to-Real loop connecting reconstruction of a captured workspace, execution-grounded programmatic policy development, and real-robot execution. Robot-anchored registration establishes metric scale; reference-view depth and appearance feedback guide scene reconstruction, while MuJoCo ( Todorov et al., 2012 ) checks task-relevant physical interactions. Policy development progresses from privileged information to visual observations and then randomized simulation. A program can observe and act repeatedly within one invocation, and the agent uses execution outcomes to decide how to continue or recover. During transfer, the policy and experience memory carry task knowledge into real-robot execution; the agent adapts its subsequent behavior to real observations, while robot-side safety mechanisms constrain its actions. The central contribution is a task-level loop in which scene reconstruction, executable policies, and real-world execution feedback inform one another.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍Agentic RSR,一个Real-to-Sim-to-Real环路,连接一个被捕获的工作空间的重建,基于执行的方案政策的制定,以及真实的机器人执行. 机器人安居登记建立了衡量尺度;参考视图深度和外观反馈指导场景重建,而MuJoCo(Todorov等人,2012年)则检查与任务相关的物理互动。 政策制定从特权信息到视觉观测,然后是随机模拟。 一个程序可以在一次引用中观察并反复行动,代理使用执行结果来决定如何继续或恢复. 在转移过程中,政策和体验内存将任务知识带入了真机器人执行中;代理者将其后续的行为适应真实的观测,而机器人侧安全机制则制约其行动. 中心贡献是任务层面的循环,其中场景重建,可执行政策和现实世界执行反馈相互通报.

blocks.en: # Stage 3 physical plausibility agent You are an independent Codex session assessing a Stage 3 MuJoCo tabletop scene **before** any downstream manipulation task. Your objective is to find and, only when justified, repair obviously implausible physics while preserving the original scene. A simulation sanity check cannot establish agreement with reality: distinguish prior guesses, measured real-world evidence, and simulation outputs. Inputs below provide the absolute scene path, immutable prior-hypotheses JSON, and a third-person overview. The overview is an independent free camera, **not** one of the four reference cameras. Inspect the attached image and the observation JSON; query the scene yourself. Do not assume the visual appearance proves mass or friction. If a visual force prior path is given, read it before querying physical properties: it was estimated in a separate turn using only the image and Stage 2 plan. Treat it as a broad, uncertain hypothesis, never as a measured target. Collision repair tools: `python -m real2sim.stage3.physics_probe patch --scene SCENE --patch-file OUTPUT/repair.json --output OUTPUT/candidate.xml` accepts named task bodies with `collision` (a dict with `geom`, `mode`: `none` for a non-supporting static backdrop only, or `box` plus `pos` and positive half-`size` in metres), `center_of_mass: [x,y,z]` in body-local coordinates, and `mass_kg`. Change only a named collision geom; never remove a tabletop/container support or any moving body’s collider. A backdrop’s visible mesh remains intact when its collision geom is removed. For a folded paper/pouch, a visual mesh can be left untouched while a flat thin contact box represents only the exposed contact area; place its mass center over actual support (not simply lower z). These are hypotheses: test one cause at a time (wrong backdrop, contact proxy, center of mass, mass) in separate candidate XMLs and static reports. A low center of mass alone cannot resolve collider penetration.
